title: Roof Replacement in Oregon City, OR
summary: In April 2025, French Roofing replaced a mossy shingle roof on a home in Oregon City, OR. The crew took the old roof off down to the decking, laid new underlayment, and installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles in a brown blend, with new valley and wall flashing, drip edge, ridge cap, roof vents and pipe boots.
scope: Removed the old shingles and roof system down to the decking and re-nailed loose wood
Installed underlayment directly on the roof deck, plus drip edge and edge metal flashing
Installed metal valley flashing and L-shaped flashing under the shingles where the roof meets the walls
Installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles with starter shingles along the edges and ridge cap shingles on the ridges and hips
New roof vents for attic airflow and new flashing boots around the plumbing vent pipes
Cleaned up and hauled off all job debris and magnet swept the site for nails

faqs.question: Did the old roof come off on this Oregon City job?
faqs.answer: Yes. The old shingles and roof system came off down to the decking, and loose wood was re-nailed before the new underlayment and shingles went on.
